#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
THE STATE OF GLOBAL EDUCATION — Monumental Contrast
A1 portrait poster: 3508 × 4967 px (150 DPI)
Second pass: refined craftsmanship, dramatic contrast, museum quality
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import math, os

# ─── Dimensions ─────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 3508, 4967
MARGIN = 240
COL_W = W - 2 * MARGIN

# ─── Color Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────
BG          = (8, 16, 32)
BG_CARD     = (14, 26, 48)
BG_CARD2    = (16, 28, 50)
AMBER       = (235, 160, 55)
AMBER_DIM   = (100, 68, 24)
CORAL       = (228, 82, 62)
CORAL_DIM   = (95, 38, 28)
CORAL_GLOW  = (180, 55, 40)
TEAL        = (40, 175, 120)
TEAL_DIM    = (20, 78, 52)
WHITE       = (245, 245, 245)
MUTED       = (120, 138, 178)
SOFT_WHITE  = (195, 204, 222)
DIM_LINE    = (30, 44, 70)
FAINT       = (20, 32, 55)
NEAR_BLACK  = (12, 20, 36)

# ─── Font Loader ────────────────────────────────────────────
FDIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"
def font(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FDIR, name), size)

# ─── Fonts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
F_TITLE       = font("YoungSerif-Regular.ttf", 78)
F_SUBTITLE    = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 34)
F_HERO_NUM    = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 420)
F_HERO_LABEL  = font("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 52)
F_SECTION     = font("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 36)
F_BODY        = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 28)
F_BODY_BOLD   = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 28)
F_SMALL       = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 24)
F_TINY        = font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 20)
F_DATA        = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 68)
F_COMPARE     = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 110)
F_YEAR        = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 32)
F_METRIC      = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 88)
F_ANNOTATION  = font("Jura-Light.ttf", 22)
F_FOOTER      = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 19)
F_CARD_LABEL  = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 28)
F_MEGA        = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 520)

# ─── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────
def text_w(draw, text, fnt):
    return draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=fnt)[2] - draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=fnt)[0]

def text_h(draw, text, fnt):
    return draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=fnt)[3] - draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=fnt)[1]

def centered(draw, y, text, fnt, fill, cx=None):
    if cx is None: cx = W // 2
    tw = text_w(draw, text, fnt)
    draw.text((cx - tw // 2, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)
    return text_h(draw, text, fnt)

def left_text(draw, x, y, text, fnt, fill):
    draw.text((x, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)
    return text_h(draw, text, fnt)

def right_text(draw, x, y, text, fnt, fill):
    tw = text_w(draw, text, fnt)
    draw.text((x - tw, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)
    return text_h(draw, text, fnt)

def h_rule(draw, y, x1=MARGIN, x2=W - MARGIN, color=DIM_LINE, width=1):
    draw.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=color, width=width)

def rrect(draw, xy, fill, radius=10):
    draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=radius, fill=fill)

def gradient_rect(img, x0, y0, x1, y1, c_top, c_bot):
    """Draw a vertical gradient rectangle."""
    for row in range(y0, y1):
        t = (row - y0) / max(1, (y1 - y0))
        r = int(c_top[0] + (c_bot[0] - c_top[0]) * t)
        g = int(c_top[1] + (c_bot[1] - c_top[1]) * t)
        b = int(c_top[2] + (c_bot[2] - c_top[2]) * t)
        draw_img = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
        draw_img.line([(x0, row), (x1, row)], fill=(r, g, b))


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CREATE CANVAS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Subtle top gradient band for depth
gradient_rect(img, 0, 0, W, 400, (15, 25, 50), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)


# ╀─ HEADER RULE ──────────────────────────────────────────────
y = MARGIN
# Double rule: thin amber + thin white
h_rule(draw, y, color=AMBER, width=2)
h_rule(draw, y + 8, color=DIM_LINE, width=1)
y += 40


# ─── SECTION 1: TITLE ───────────────────────────────────────
centered(draw, y, "THE STATE OF GLOBAL EDUCATION", F_TITLE, WHITE)
y += text_h(draw, "THE STATE OF GLOBAL EDUCATION", F_TITLE) + 18

# Subtitle with accent
sub = "Progress, Gaps, and Inequality"
centered(draw, y, sub, F_SUBTITLE, MUTED)
y += text_h(draw, sub, F_SUBTITLE) + 40

h_rule(draw, y, color=DIM_LINE, width=1)
y += 55


# ─── SECTION 2: HISTORICAL PROGRESS ────────────────────────
left_text(draw, MARGIN, y, "TWO CENTURIES OF EXPANSION", F_SECTION, WHITE)
y += 42
draw.line([(MARGIN, y), (MARGIN + 160, y)], fill=AMBER, width=3)
y += 28

left_text(draw, MARGIN, y, "In 1800, fewer than 1 in 5 adults had any formal education.", F_BODY, MUTED)
y += 36
left_text(draw, MARGIN, y, "Today, more than 4 in 5 adults have received formal schooling.", F_BODY, SOFT_WHITE)
y += 55

# ── Proportion Bars ──
BAR_H = 52
BAR_R = 6

# 1800 bar
left_text(draw, MARGIN, y, "1800", F_YEAR, MUTED)
y += 36
pct_1800 = 0.17
bar_fill_1800 = int(COL_W * pct_1800)
rrect(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN + COL_W, y + BAR_H), fill=FAINT, radius=BAR_R)
rrect(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN + bar_fill_1800, y + BAR_H), fill=AMBER_DIM, radius=BAR_R)
left_text(draw, MARGIN + bar_fill_1800 + 18, y + 10, "< 1 in 5", F_BODY_BOLD, AMBER)
y += BAR_H + 28

# Transformation arrow: vertical dashed line with subtle chevrons
arrow_x = MARGIN + COL_W // 2
for iy in range(y, y + 52, 7):
    draw.line([(arrow_x, iy), (arrow_x, iy + 3)], fill=DIM_LINE, width=1)
# Small downward chevrons
for i in range(3):
    cy = y + 8 + i * 18
    draw.polygon([(arrow_x - 8, cy), (arrow_x, cy + 8), (arrow_x + 8, cy)], fill=TEAL_DIM)
y += 70

# Today bar
left_text(draw, MARGIN, y, "TODAY", F_YEAR, TEAL)
y += 36
pct_today = 0.83
bar_fill_today = int(COL_W * pct_today)
rrect(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN + COL_W, y + BAR_H), fill=FAINT, radius=BAR_R)
rrect(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN + bar_fill_today, y + BAR_H), fill=TEAL, radius=BAR_R)
left_text(draw, MARGIN + bar_fill_today + 18, y + 10, "> 4 in 5", F_BODY_BOLD, TEAL)
y += BAR_H + 35

h_rule(draw, y, color=DIM_LINE, width=1)
y += 55


# ─── SECTION 3: 244 MILLION — HERO STAT ────────────────────
# Dramatic card with darker background
CARD_PAD = 50
CARD_TOP = y - 20
CARD_H = 700  # Reserve space for the hero card
rrect(draw, (MARGIN - CARD_PAD, CARD_TOP, W - MARGIN + CARD_PAD, CARD_TOP + CARD_H), fill=BG_CARD, radius=14)

# Subtle inner border
draw.rounded_rectangle(
    (MARGIN - CARD_PAD + 2, CARD_TOP + 2, W - MARGIN + CARD_PAD - 2, CARD_TOP + CARD_H - 2),
    radius=13, outline=DIM_LINE, width=1
)

y += 20

# Label
left_text(draw, MARGIN + 10, y, "OUT OF SCHOOL", F_CARD_LABEL, CORAL)
y += 50

# Hero number — absolutely dominant
num = "244"
centered(draw, y, num, F_HERO_NUM, CORAL)
y += text_h(draw, num, F_HERO_NUM) + 2

# MILLION
centered(draw, y, "MILLION", F_HERO_LABEL, WHITE)
y += text_h(draw, "MILLION", F_HERO_LABEL) + 12

# CHILDREN — large but lighter
centered(draw, y, "CHILDREN", F_COMPARE, CORAL_DIM)
y += text_h(draw, "CHILDREN", F_COMPARE) + 30

# Breakdown
centered(draw, y, "~60 million primary-age  ·  ~184 million secondary-age", F_SMALL, MUTED)
y += 42

# ── Dot matrix: each dot = 1 million ──
DOT_R = 6
DOT_GAP_X = 22
DOT_GAP_Y = 22
DOT_COLS = 22
dot_count = 244
DOT_ROWS = math.ceil(dot_count / DOT_COLS)  # 12 rows

dot_total_w = DOT_COLS * DOT_GAP_X
dot_start_x = W // 2 - dot_total_w // 2 + DOT_GAP_X // 2
dot_start_y = y

count = 0
for row in range(DOT_ROWS):
    cols_in_row = min(DOT_COLS, dot_count - count)
    for col in range(cols_in_row):
        cx = dot_start_x + col * DOT_GAP_X
        cy = dot_start_y + row * DOT_GAP_Y
        if count < 60:
            draw.ellipse([cx - DOT_R, cy - DOT_R, cx + DOT_R, cy + DOT_R], fill=CORAL)
        else:
            draw.ellipse([cx - DOT_R, cy - DOT_R, cx + DOT_R, cy + DOT_R], fill=CORAL_DIM)
        count += 1

dot_end_y = dot_start_y + DOT_ROWS * DOT_GAP_Y
y = dot_end_y + 8

# Legend dots
lx = dot_start_x
left_text(draw, lx, y, "●", F_TINY, CORAL)
left_text(draw, lx + 24, y, "Primary-age", F_TINY, MUTED)
left_text(draw, lx + 160, y, "●", F_TINY, CORAL_DIM)
left_text(draw, lx + 184, y, "Secondary-age", F_TINY, MUTED)

y = CARD_TOP + CARD_H + 40

h_rule(draw, y, color=DIM_LINE, width=1)
y += 55


# ─── SECTION 4: QUALITY SCHOOLING — THE DIVIDE ─────────────
left_text(draw, MARGIN, y, "LEARNING-ADJUSTED YEARS OF SCHOOLING", F_SECTION, WHITE)
y += 42
draw.line([(MARGIN, y), (MARGIN + 200, y)], fill=AMBER, width=3)
y += 28

left_text(draw, MARGIN, y, "Quality schooling received: a world divided", F_BODY, MUTED)
y += 55

# ── Vertical bar comparison ──
COMPARE_MAX = 12
COMPARE_H = 440
BAR_W = 180
INNER_GAP = 320

left_x = W // 2 - INNER_GAP // 2 - BAR_W
right_x = W // 2 + INNER_GAP // 2
bar_bottom = y + COMPARE_H

# Left: poorest (< 3 years)
poor_h = int(COMPARE_H * (3 / COMPARE_MAX))
rrect(draw, (left_x, y, left_x + BAR_W, bar_bottom), fill=FAINT, radius=8)
rrect(draw, (left_x, bar_bottom - poor_h, left_x + BAR_W, bar_bottom), fill=CORAL, radius=8)
# Number inside the bar
centered(draw, bar_bottom - poor_h + 16, "< 3", F_COMPARE, WHITE, left_x + BAR_W // 2)
# Labels
centered(draw, bar_bottom + 14, "YEARS", F_BODY_BOLD, CORAL, left_x + BAR_W // 2)
centered(draw, bar_bottom + 48, "Poorest countries", F_BODY, MUTED, left_x + BAR_W // 2)

# Right: richest (10+ years)
rich_h = int(COMPARE_H * (10.5 / COMPARE_MAX))
rrect(draw, (right_x, y, right_x + BAR_W, bar_bottom), fill=FAINT, radius=8)
rrect(draw, (right_x, bar_bottom - rich_h, right_x + BAR_W, bar_bottom), fill=AMBER, radius=8)
centered(draw, bar_bottom - rich_h + 16, "10+", F_COMPARE, WHITE, right_x + BAR_W // 2)
centered(draw, bar_bottom + 14, "YEARS", F_BODY_BOLD, AMBER, right_x + BAR_W // 2)
centered(draw, bar_bottom + 48, "Richest countries", F_BODY, MUTED, right_x + BAR_W // 2)

# VS divider
centered(draw, y + COMPARE_H // 2 - 24, "VS", F_COMPARE, DIM_LINE, W // 2)

# Scale markers
for yr in range(0, 13, 3):
    my = bar_bottom - int(COMPARE_H * (yr / COMPARE_MAX))
    draw.line([(left_x - 25, my), (left_x - 8, my)], fill=DIM_LINE, width=1)
    right_text(draw, left_x - 34, my - 9, str(yr), F_TINY, MUTED)

# Bracket annotation: "Children in the poorest nations receive less than a third"
# Small text between the two bars, mid-height
mid_y = bar_bottom - rich_h // 2
ann_x = W // 2
# Horizontal lines connecting to both bars
draw.line([(left_x + BAR_W + 10, mid_y), (right_x - 10, mid_y)], fill=DIM_LINE, width=1)
# Small text
ann_text = "Less than a third"
centered(draw, mid_y - 24, ann_text, F_SMALL, MUTED, ann_x)
ann_text2 = "of quality schooling"
centered(draw, mid_y + 4, ann_text2, F_SMALL, MUTED, ann_x)

y = bar_bottom + 90
h_rule(draw, y, color=DIM_LINE, width=1)
y += 55


# ─── SECTION 5: LEARNING CRISIS ─────────────────────────────
left_text(draw, MARGIN, y, "THE LEARNING CRISIS", F_SECTION, WHITE)
y += 42
draw.line([(MARGIN, y), (MARGIN + 140, y)], fill=CORAL, width=3)
y += 26

left_text(draw, MARGIN, y, "Enrollment does not guarantee learning.", F_BODY, SOFT_WHITE)
y += 42

# Metric with proportion bar
SMALL_BAR_H = 36
small_bar_w = COL_W // 2 - 60
prof_pct = 0.17
prof_fill = int(small_bar_w * prof_pct)

rrect(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN + small_bar_w, y + SMALL_BAR_H), fill=FAINT, radius=5)
rrect(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN + prof_fill, y + SMALL_BAR_H), fill=CORAL, radius=5)

mx = MARGIN + small_bar_w + 30
left_text(draw, mx, y - 6, "< 20%", F_METRIC, CORAL)
left_text(draw, mx, y + 68, "of children achieve minimum", F_BODY, MUTED)
left_text(draw, mx, y + 98, "reading proficiency in low-income countries", F_BODY, MUTED)

y += SMALL_BAR_H + 125
h_rule(draw, y, color=DIM_LINE, width=1)
y += 55


# ─── SECTION 6: GENDER GAP ─────────────────────────────────
left_text(draw, MARGIN, y, "CLOSING THE GENDER GAP", F_SECTION, WHITE)
y += 42
draw.line([(MARGIN, y), (MARGIN + 160, y)], fill=TEAL, width=3)
y += 26

# Three level indicators in a row
GAP_COL = (COL_W - 60) // 3
GAP_BAR_H = 12

levels = [
    ("Primary",   0.98, "Nearly closed",       TEAL_DIM),
    ("Secondary", 0.96, "Nearly closed",       TEAL_DIM),
    ("Tertiary",  1.05, "Women exceed men",    TEAL),
]

for i, (label, ratio, status, col) in enumerate(levels):
    bx = MARGIN + i * (GAP_COL + 30)
    left_text(draw, bx, y, label, F_BODY_BOLD, SOFT_WHITE)
    by = y + 34
    bar_fill = int(GAP_COL * min(ratio, 1.0))
    rrect(draw, (bx, by, bx + GAP_COL, by + GAP_BAR_H), fill=FAINT, radius=4)
    rrect(draw, (bx, by, bx + bar_fill, by + GAP_BAR_H), fill=col, radius=4)
    left_text(draw, bx, by + GAP_BAR_H + 10, status, F_SMALL, MUTED)

y += 34 + GAP_BAR_H + 50

# Exception note
left_text(draw, MARGIN, y, "Exception: In Afghanistan, girls remain far less likely to attend school.", F_SMALL, CORAL_DIM)
y += 45

h_rule(draw, y, color=DIM_LINE, width=1)
y += 50


# ─── SECTION 7: KEY TAKEAWAY ────────────────────────────────
TK_PAD = 30
tk_top = y - 10
tk_bot = y + 150
rrect(draw, (MARGIN - TK_PAD, tk_top, W - MARGIN + TK_PAD, tk_bot), fill=BG_CARD2, radius=10)
draw.rounded_rectangle(
    (MARGIN - TK_PAD + 1, tk_top + 1, W - MARGIN + TK_PAD - 1, tk_bot - 1),
    radius=9, outline=DIM_LINE, width=1
)

y += 8
left_text(draw, MARGIN + 8, y, "KEY TAKEAWAY", F_CARD_LABEL, AMBER)
y += 40

tk_lines = [
    "Remarkable progress — but the job is far from done.",
    "Hundreds of millions of children are out of school or learning very little.",
    "Closing the gap between enrollment and learning, and between rich and poor",
    "nations, is one of the most pressing challenges of our time.",
]
for line in tk_lines:
    left_text(draw, MARGIN + 8, y, line, F_BODY, SOFT_WHITE)
    y += 32

y = tk_bot + 30


# ─── FOOTER ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
footer_y = H - MARGIN + 10
h_rule(draw, footer_y - 25, color=DIM_LINE, width=1)
left_text(draw, MARGIN, footer_y, "Sources: UNESCO Institute for Statistics · World Bank · Global Education Monitoring Report", F_FOOTER, MUTED)
right_text(draw, W - MARGIN, footer_y, "A1 Exhibition Poster · 2023 Data", F_FOOTER, MUTED)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SAVE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
out_path = "/app/output/final_poster.png"
img.save(out_path, "PNG", optimize=True)
print(f"Saved: {out_path}  ({W}×{H}px)")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
THE STATE OF GLOBAL EDUCATION — Monumental Contrast
A1 portrait poster: 3508 × 4967 px (150 DPI)
Third pass: museum-quality refinement — depth, texture, dramatic scale
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import math, os

# ─── Dimensions ─────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 3508, 4967
MARGIN = 240
COL_W = W - 2 * MARGIN

# ─── Color Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────
BG          = (8, 15, 30)
BG_CARD     = (13, 24, 44)
BG_DEEP     = (5, 11, 24)
AMBER       = (238, 162, 52)
AMBER_DIM   = (95, 65, 20)
AMBER_GLOW  = (200, 135, 40)
CORAL       = (230, 78, 58)
CORAL_DIM   = (90, 35, 25)
CORAL_SOFT  = (180, 60, 42)
TEAL        = (38, 178, 118)
TEAL_DIM    = (18, 75, 50)
WHITE       = (248, 248, 248)
MUTED       = (115, 133, 172)
SOFT_WHITE  = (190, 200, 218)
DIM_LINE    = (28, 42, 68)
FAINT       = (18, 30, 52)
GRID_LINE   = (14, 24, 42)

# ─── Font Loader ────────────────────────────────────────────
FDIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"
def font(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FDIR, name), size)

# ─── Fonts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
F_TITLE       = font("YoungSerif-Regular.ttf", 76)
F_SUBTITLE    = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 33)
F_HERO_NUM    = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 440)
F_HERO_LABEL  = font("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 54)
F_SECTION     = font("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 35)
F_BODY        = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 27)
F_BODY_BOLD   = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 27)
F_SMALL       = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 23)
F_TINY        = font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 19)
F_COMPARE     = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 108)
F_YEAR        = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 30)
F_METRIC      = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 86)
F_CARD_LABEL  = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 26)
F_FOOTER      = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 18)
F_MEGA        = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 160)

# ─── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────
def tw(draw, text, fnt):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=fnt)
    return bb[2] - bb[0]

def th(draw, text, fnt):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=fnt)
    return bb[3] - bb[1]

def center(draw, y, text, fnt, fill, cx=None):
    if cx is None: cx = W // 2
    t = tw(draw, text, fnt)
    draw.text((cx - t // 2, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)
    return th(draw, text, fnt)

def ltext(draw, x, y, text, fnt, fill):
    draw.text((x, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)
    return th(draw, text, fnt)

def rtext(draw, x, y, text, fnt, fill):
    t = tw(draw, text, fnt)
    draw.text((x - t, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)
    return th(draw, text, fnt)

def hrule(draw, y, x1=MARGIN, x2=W - MARGIN, color=DIM_LINE, width=1):
    draw.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=color, width=width)

def rrect(draw, xy, fill, radius=10, outline=None, width=1):
    if outline:
        draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=radius, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=width)
    else:
        draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=radius, fill=fill)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CREATE CANVAS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# ── Subtle background grid (measurement/survey markers) ──
# Very faint vertical and horizontal lines suggesting a coordinate system
for gx in range(MARGIN, W - MARGIN + 1, 100):
    draw.line([(gx, 0), (gx, H)], fill=GRID_LINE, width=1)
for gy in range(0, H, 100):
    draw.line([(0, gy), (W, gy)], fill=GRID_LINE, width=1)

# Subtle top gradient for depth
for row in range(500):
    t = row / 500
    r = int(15 * (1 - t) + BG[0] * t)
    g = int(26 * (1 - t) + BG[1] * t)
    b = int(52 * (1 - t) + BG[2] * t)
    draw.line([(0, row), (W, row)], fill=(r, g, b))


# ╀─ HEADER ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
y = MARGIN
# Double accent rule
hrule(draw, y, color=AMBER, width=2)
hrule(draw, y + 7, color=(50, 65, 95), width=1)
y += 38


# ─── SECTION 1: TITLE ───────────────────────────────────────
center(draw, y, "THE STATE OF GLOBAL EDUCATION", F_TITLE, WHITE)
y += th(draw, "THE STATE OF GLOBAL EDUCATION", F_TITLE) + 14

center(draw, y, "Progress, Gaps, and Inequality", F_SUBTITLE, MUTED)
y += th(draw, "Progress, Gaps, and Inequality", F_SUBTITLE) + 35

hrule(draw, y)
y += 50


# ─── SECTION 2: HISTORICAL PROGRESS ────────────────────────
ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "TWO CENTURIES OF EXPANSION", F_SECTION, WHITE)
y += 40
# Amber accent bar
draw.line([(MARGIN, y), (MARGIN + 140, y)], fill=AMBER, width=3)
y += 25

ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "In 1800, fewer than 1 in 5 adults had any formal education.", F_BODY, MUTED)
y += 34
ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "Today, more than 4 in 5 adults have received formal schooling.", F_BODY, SOFT_WHITE)
y += 48

# ── Proportion Bars ──
BAR_H = 48
BAR_R = 6

# 1800
ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "1800", F_YEAR, MUTED)
y += 32
fill_1800 = int(COL_W * 0.17)
rrect(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN + COL_W, y + BAR_H), fill=FAINT, radius=BAR_R)
rrect(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN + fill_1800, y + BAR_H), fill=AMBER_DIM, radius=BAR_R)
ltext(draw, MARGIN + fill_1800 + 16, y + 9, "< 1 in 5", F_BODY_BOLD, AMBER)
y += BAR_H + 22

# Transformation indicator — subtle dashed vertical with chevrons
ax = MARGIN + COL_W // 2
for iy in range(y, y + 44, 7):
    draw.line([(ax, iy), (ax, iy + 3)], fill=DIM_LINE, width=1)
for i in range(3):
    cy = y + 6 + i * 16
    draw.polygon([(ax - 7, cy), (ax, cy + 7), (ax + 7, cy)], fill=TEAL_DIM)
y += 60

# Today
ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "TODAY", F_YEAR, TEAL)
y += 32
fill_today = int(COL_W * 0.83)
rrect(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN + COL_W, y + BAR_H), fill=FAINT, radius=BAR_R)
rrect(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN + fill_today, y + BAR_H), fill=TEAL, radius=BAR_R)
ltext(draw, MARGIN + fill_today + 16, y + 9, "> 4 in 5", F_BODY_BOLD, TEAL)
y += BAR_H + 30

hrule(draw, y)
y += 48


# ─── SECTION 3: 244 MILLION — HERO ─────────────────────────
# The visual center of the poster. Deep card, massive numerals.

CARD_PAD = 50
CARD_TOP = y - 16
CARD_H = 680
rrect(draw, (MARGIN - CARD_PAD, CARD_TOP, W - MARGIN + CARD_PAD, CARD_TOP + CARD_H),
      fill=BG_CARD, radius=14, outline=DIM_LINE, width=1)

y += 16

# Label
ltext(draw, MARGIN + 10, y, "OUT OF SCHOOL", F_CARD_LABEL, CORAL)
y += 44

# MONUMENTAL number
num = "244"
center(draw, y, num, F_HERO_NUM, CORAL)
y += th(draw, num, F_HERO_NUM) + 0

# MILLION
center(draw, y, "MILLION", F_HERO_LABEL, WHITE)
y += th(draw, "MILLION", F_HERO_LABEL) + 8

# CHILDREN
center(draw, y, "CHILDREN", F_COMPARE, CORAL_DIM)
y += th(draw, "CHILDREN", F_COMPARE) + 26

# Breakdown
center(draw, y, "~60 million primary-age  ·  ~184 million secondary-age", F_SMALL, MUTED)
y += 38

# ── Dot Matrix ──
# 244 dots, each = 1 million. Larger, bolder arrangement.
DOT_R = 7
DOT_GAP = 22
DOT_COLS = 20
dot_total = 244
DOT_ROWS = math.ceil(dot_total / DOT_COLS)  # 13

dot_w = DOT_COLS * DOT_GAP
dot_sx = W // 2 - dot_w // 2 + DOT_GAP // 2
dot_sy = y

count = 0
for row in range(DOT_ROWS):
    n = min(DOT_COLS, dot_total - count)
    for col in range(n):
        cx = dot_sx + col * DOT_GAP
        cy = dot_sy + row * DOT_GAP
        if count < 60:

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
THE STATE OF GLOBAL EDUCATION — Monumental Contrast
A1 portrait poster: 3508 × 4967 px (150 DPI)
Third pass: museum-quality refinement — depth, texture, dramatic scale
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import math, os

# ─── Dimensions ─────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 3508, 4967
MARGIN = 240
COL_W = W - 2 * MARGIN

# ─── Color Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────
BG          = (8, 15, 30)
BG_CARD     = (13, 24, 44)
BG_DEEP     = (5, 11, 24)
AMBER       = (238, 162, 52)
AMBER_DIM   = (95, 65, 20)
AMBER_GLOW  = (200, 135, 40)
CORAL       = (230, 78, 58)
CORAL_DIM   = (90, 35, 25)
CORAL_SOFT  = (180, 60, 42)
TEAL        = (38, 178, 118)
TEAL_DIM    = (18, 75, 50)
WHITE       = (248, 248, 248)
MUTED       = (115, 133, 172)
SOFT_WHITE  = (190, 200, 218)
DIM_LINE    = (28, 42, 68)
FAINT       = (18, 30, 52)
GRID_LINE   = (14, 24, 42)

# ─── Font Loader ────────────────────────────────────────────
FDIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"
def font(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FDIR, name), size)

# ─── Fonts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
F_TITLE       = font("YoungSerif-Regular.ttf", 76)
F_SUBTITLE    = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 33)
F_HERO_NUM    = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 440)
F_HERO_LABEL  = font("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 54)
F_SECTION     = font("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 35)
F_BODY        = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 27)
F_BODY_BOLD   = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 27)
F_SMALL       = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 23)
F_TINY        = font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 19)
F_COMPARE     = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 108)
F_YEAR        = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 30)
F_METRIC      = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 86)
F_CARD_LABEL  = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 26)
F_FOOTER      = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 18)
F_MEGA        = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 160)

# ─── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────
def tw(draw, text, fnt):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=fnt)
    return bb[2] - bb[0]

def th(draw, text, fnt):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=fnt)
    return bb[3] - bb[1]

def center(draw, y, text, fnt, fill, cx=None):
    if cx is None: cx = W // 2
    t = tw(draw, text, fnt)
    draw.text((cx - t // 2, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)
    return th(draw, text, fnt)

def ltext(draw, x, y, text, fnt, fill):
    draw.text((x, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)
    return th(draw, text, fnt)

def rtext(draw, x, y, text, fnt, fill):
    t = tw(draw, text, fnt)
    draw.text((x - t, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)
    return th(draw, text, fnt)

def hrule(draw, y, x1=MARGIN, x2=W - MARGIN, color=DIM_LINE, width=1):
    draw.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=color, width=width)

def rrect(draw, xy, fill, radius=10, outline=None, width=1):
    if outline:
        draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=radius, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=width)
    else:
        draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=radius, fill=fill)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CREATE CANVAS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# ── Subtle background grid (measurement/survey markers) ──
# Very faint vertical and horizontal lines suggesting a coordinate system
for gx in range(MARGIN, W - MARGIN + 1, 100):
    draw.line([(gx, 0), (gx, H)], fill=GRID_LINE, width=1)
for gy in range(0, H, 100):
    draw.line([(0, gy), (W, gy)], fill=GRID_LINE, width=1)

# Subtle top gradient for depth
for row in range(500):
    t = row / 500
    r = int(15 * (1 - t) + BG[0] * t)
    g = int(26 * (1 - t) + BG[1] * t)
    b = int(52 * (1 - t) + BG[2] * t)
    draw.line([(0, row), (W, row)], fill=(r, g, b))


# ╀─ HEADER ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
y = MARGIN
# Double accent rule
hrule(draw, y, color=AMBER, width=2)
hrule(draw, y + 7, color=(50, 65, 95), width=1)
y += 38


# ─── SECTION 1: TITLE ───────────────────────────────────────
center(draw, y, "THE STATE OF GLOBAL EDUCATION", F_TITLE, WHITE)
y += th(draw, "THE STATE OF GLOBAL EDUCATION", F_TITLE) + 14

center(draw, y, "Progress, Gaps, and Inequality", F_SUBTITLE, MUTED)
y += th(draw, "Progress, Gaps, and Inequality", F_SUBTITLE) + 35

hrule(draw, y)
y += 50


# ─── SECTION 2: HISTORICAL PROGRESS ────────────────────────
ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "TWO CENTURIES OF EXPANSION", F_SECTION, WHITE)
y += 40
# Amber accent bar
draw.line([(MARGIN, y), (MARGIN + 140, y)], fill=AMBER, width=3)
y += 25

ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "In 1800, fewer than 1 in 5 adults had any formal education.", F_BODY, MUTED)
y += 34
ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "Today, more than 4 in 5 adults have received formal schooling.", F_BODY, SOFT_WHITE)
y += 48

# ── Proportion Bars ──
BAR_H = 48
BAR_R = 6

# 1800
ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "1800", F_YEAR, MUTED)
y += 32
fill_1800 = int(COL_W * 0.17)
rrect(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN + COL_W, y + BAR_H), fill=FAINT, radius=BAR_R)
rrect(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN + fill_1800, y + BAR_H), fill=AMBER_DIM, radius=BAR_R)
ltext(draw, MARGIN + fill_1800 + 16, y + 9, "< 1 in 5", F_BODY_BOLD, AMBER)
y += BAR_H + 22

# Transformation indicator — subtle dashed vertical with chevrons
ax = MARGIN + COL_W // 2
for iy in range(y, y + 44, 7):
    draw.line([(ax, iy), (ax, iy + 3)], fill=DIM_LINE, width=1)
for i in range(3):
    cy = y + 6 + i * 16
    draw.polygon([(ax - 7, cy), (ax, cy + 7), (ax + 7, cy)], fill=TEAL_DIM)
y += 60

# Today
ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "TODAY", F_YEAR, TEAL)
y += 32
fill_today = int(COL_W * 0.83)
rrect(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN + COL_W, y + BAR_H), fill=FAINT, radius=BAR_R)
rrect(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN + fill_today, y + BAR_H), fill=TEAL, radius=BAR_R)
ltext(draw, MARGIN + fill_today + 16, y + 9, "> 4 in 5", F_BODY_BOLD, TEAL)
y += BAR_H + 30

hrule(draw, y)
y += 48


# ─── SECTION 3: 244 MILLION — HERO ─────────────────────────
# The visual center of the poster. Deep card, massive numerals.

CARD_PAD = 50
CARD_TOP = y - 16
CARD_H = 680
rrect(draw, (MARGIN - CARD_PAD, CARD_TOP, W - MARGIN + CARD_PAD, CARD_TOP + CARD_H),
      fill=BG_CARD, radius=14, outline=DIM_LINE, width=1)

y += 16

# Label
ltext(draw, MARGIN + 10, y, "OUT OF SCHOOL", F_CARD_LABEL, CORAL)
y += 44

# MONUMENTAL number
num = "244"
center(draw, y, num, F_HERO_NUM, CORAL)
y += th(draw, num, F_HERO_NUM) + 0

# MILLION
center(draw, y, "MILLION", F_HERO_LABEL, WHITE)
y += th(draw, "MILLION", F_HERO_LABEL) + 8

# CHILDREN
center(draw, y, "CHILDREN", F_COMPARE, CORAL_DIM)
y += th(draw, "CHILDREN", F_COMPARE) + 26

# Breakdown
center(draw, y, "~60 million primary-age  ·  ~184 million secondary-age", F_SMALL, MUTED)
y += 38

# ── Dot Matrix ──
# 244 dots, each = 1 million. Larger, bolder arrangement.
DOT_R = 7
DOT_GAP = 22
DOT_COLS = 20
dot_total = 244
DOT_ROWS = math.ceil(dot_total / DOT_COLS)  # 13

dot_w = DOT_COLS * DOT_GAP
dot_sx = W // 2 - dot_w // 2 + DOT_GAP // 2
dot_sy = y

count = 0
for row in range(DOT_ROWS):
    n = min(DOT_COLS, dot_total - count)
    for col in range(n):
        cx = dot_sx + col * DOT_GAP
        cy = dot_sy + row * DOT_GAP
        if count < 60:
            draw.ellipse([cx - DOT_R, cy - DOT_R, cx + DOT_R, cy + DOT_R], fill=CORAL)
        else:
            draw.ellipse([cx - DOT_R, cy - DOT_R, cx + DOT_R, cy + DOT_R], fill=CORAL_DIM)
        count += 1

dot_ey = dot_sy + DOT_ROWS * DOT_GAP
y = dot_ey + 6

# Legend
lx = dot_sx
ltext(draw, lx, y, "●", F_TINY, CORAL)
ltext(draw, lx + 22, y, "Primary-age", F_TINY, MUTED)
ltext(draw, lx + 148, y, "●", F_TINY, CORAL_DIM)
ltext(draw, lx + 170, y, "Secondary-age", F_TINY, MUTED)

y = CARD_TOP + CARD_H + 32
hrule(draw, y)
y += 48


# ─── SECTION 4: QUALITY SCHOOLING — THE DIVIDE ─────────────
ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "LEARNING-ADJUSTED YEARS OF SCHOOLING", F_SECTION, WHITE)
y += 40
draw.line([(MARGIN, y), (MARGIN + 185, y)], fill=AMBER, width=3)
y += 24

ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "Quality schooling received: a world divided", F_BODY, MUTED)
y += 48

# ── Vertical bar comparison ──
CMP_H = 420
CMP_MAX = 12
BAR_W = 170
GAP = 320

lx = W // 2 - GAP // 2 - BAR_W
rx = W // 2 + GAP // 2
bb = y + CMP_H

# Poorest (< 3 years)
ph = int(CMP_H * (3 / CMP_MAX))
rrect(draw, (lx, y, lx + BAR_W, bb), fill=FAINT, radius=8)
rrect(draw, (lx, bb - ph, lx + BAR_W, bb), fill=CORAL, radius=8)
center(draw, bb - ph + 14, "< 3", F_COMPARE, WHITE, lx + BAR_W // 2)
center(draw, bb + 12, "YEARS", F_BODY_BOLD, CORAL, lx + BAR_W // 2)
center(draw, bb + 44, "Poorest countries", F_BODY, MUTED, lx + BAR_W // 2)

# Richest (10+ years)
rh = int(CMP_H * (10.5 / CMP_MAX))
rrect(draw, (rx, y, rx + BAR_W, bb), fill=FAINT, radius=8)
rrect(draw, (rx, bb - rh, rx + BAR_W, bb), fill=AMBER, radius=8)
center(draw, bb - rh + 14, "10+", F_COMPARE, WHITE, rx + BAR_W // 2)
center(draw, bb + 12, "YEARS", F_BODY_BOLD, AMBER, rx + BAR_W // 2)
center(draw, bb + 44, "Richest countries", F_BODY, MUTED, rx + BAR_W // 2)

# VS
center(draw, y + CMP_H // 2 - 22, "VS", F_COMPARE, DIM_LINE, W // 2)

# Scale markers
for yr in range(0, 13, 3):
    my = bb - int(CMP_H * (yr / CMP_MAX))
    draw.line([(lx - 22, my), (lx - 6, my)], fill=DIM_LINE, width=1)
    rtext(draw, lx - 30, my - 8, str(yr), F_TINY, MUTED)

# Connecting bracket annotation
mid_y = bb - rh // 2
draw.line([(lx + BAR_W + 8, mid_y), (rx - 8, mid_y)], fill=DIM_LINE, width=1)
center(draw, mid_y - 20, "Less than a third", F_SMALL, MUTED, W // 2)
center(draw, mid_y + 4, "of quality schooling", F_SMALL, MUTED, W // 2)

y = bb + 80
hrule(draw, y)
y += 48


# ─── SECTION 5: LEARNING CRISIS ─────────────────────────────
ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "THE LEARNING CRISIS", F_SECTION, WHITE)
y += 40
draw.line([(MARGIN, y), (MARGIN + 125, y)], fill=CORAL, width=3)
y += 22

ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "Enrollment does not guarantee learning.", F_BODY, SOFT_WHITE)
y += 38

# Proportion bar + metric
SB_H = 34
sb_w = COL_W // 2 - 50
pf = int(sb_w * 0.17)

rrect(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN + sb_w, y + SB_H), fill=FAINT, radius=5)
rrect(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN + pf, y + SB_H), fill=CORAL, radius=5)

mx = MARGIN + sb_w + 24
ltext(draw, mx, y - 5, "< 20%", F_METRIC, CORAL)
ltext(draw, mx, y + 65, "of children achieve minimum reading", F_BODY, MUTED)
ltext(draw, mx, y + 92, "proficiency in low-income countries", F_BODY, MUTED)

y += SB_H + 115
hrule(draw, y)
y += 48


# ─── SECTION 6: GENDER GAP ─────────────────────────────────
ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "CLOSING THE GENDER GAP", F_SECTION, WHITE)
y += 40
draw.line([(MARGIN, y), (MARGIN + 140, y)], fill=TEAL, width=3)
y += 22

GAP_COL = (COL_W - 50) // 3
GB_H = 10

levels = [
    ("Primary",   0.98, "Nearly closed",    TEAL_DIM),
    ("Secondary", 0.96, "Nearly closed",    TEAL_DIM),
    ("Tertiary",  1.05, "Women exceed men", TEAL),
]

for i, (label, ratio, status, col) in enumerate(levels):
    bx = MARGIN + i * (GAP_COL + 25)
    ltext(draw, bx, y, label, F_BODY_BOLD, SOFT_WHITE)
    by = y + 30
    bf = int(GAP_COL * min(ratio, 1.0))
    rrect(draw, (bx, by, bx + GAP_COL, by + GB_H), fill=FAINT, radius=4)
    rrect(draw, (bx, by, bx + bf, by + GB_H), fill=col, radius=4)
    ltext(draw, bx, by + GB_H + 8, status, F_SMALL, MUTED)

y += 30 + GB_H + 44

# Exception
ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "Exception: In Afghanistan, girls remain far less likely to attend school.", F_SMALL, CORAL_DIM)
y += 40

hrule(draw, y)
y += 44


# ─── SECTION 7: KEY TAKEAWAY ────────────────────────────────

tk_bot = y + 140
rrect(draw, (MARGIN - TP, tk_top, W - MARGIN + TP, tk_bot), fill=BG_CARD, radius=10, outline=DIM_LINE, width=1)

y += 4
ltext(draw, MARGIN + 6, y, "KEY TAKEAWAY", F_CARD_LABEL, AMBER)
y += 36

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
THE STATE OF GLOBAL EDUCATION — Monumental Contrast
A1 portrait poster: 3508 × 4967 px (150 DPI)
Third pass: museum-quality refinement — depth, texture, dramatic scale
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import math, os

# ─── Dimensions ─────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 3508, 4967
MARGIN = 240
COL_W = W - 2 * MARGIN

# ─── Color Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────
BG          = (8, 15, 30)
BG_CARD     = (13, 24, 44)
BG_DEEP     = (5, 11, 24)
AMBER       = (238, 162, 52)
AMBER_DIM   = (95, 65, 20)
AMBER_GLOW  = (200, 135, 40)
CORAL       = (230, 78, 58)
CORAL_DIM   = (90, 35, 25)
CORAL_SOFT  = (180, 60, 42)
TEAL        = (38, 178, 118)
TEAL_DIM    = (18, 75, 50)
WHITE       = (248, 248, 248)
MUTED       = (115, 133, 172)
SOFT_WHITE  = (190, 200, 218)
DIM_LINE    = (28, 42, 68)
FAINT       = (18, 30, 52)
GRID_LINE   = (14, 24, 42)

# ─── Font Loader ────────────────────────────────────────────
FDIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"
def font(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FDIR, name), size)

# ─── Fonts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
F_TITLE       = font("YoungSerif-Regular.ttf", 76)
F_SUBTITLE    = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 33)
F_HERO_NUM    = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 440)
F_HERO_LABEL  = font("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 54)
F_SECTION     = font("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 35)
F_BODY        = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 27)
F_BODY_BOLD   = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 27)
F_SMALL       = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 23)
F_TINY        = font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 19)
F_COMPARE     = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 108)
F_YEAR        = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 30)
F_METRIC      = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 86)
F_CARD_LABEL  = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 26)
F_FOOTER      = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 18)
F_MEGA        = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 160)

# ─── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────
def tw(draw, text, fnt):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=fnt)
    return bb[2] - bb[0]

def th(draw, text, fnt):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=fnt)
    return bb[3] - bb[1]

def center(draw, y, text, fnt, fill, cx=None):
    if cx is None: cx = W // 2
    t = tw(draw, text, fnt)
    draw.text((cx - t // 2, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)
    return th(draw, text, fnt)

def ltext(draw, x, y, text, fnt, fill):
    draw.text((x, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)
    return th(draw, text, fnt)

def rtext(draw, x, y, text, fnt, fill):
    t = tw(draw, text, fnt)
    draw.text((x - t, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)
    return th(draw, text, fnt)

def hrule(draw, y, x1=MARGIN, x2=W - MARGIN, color=DIM_LINE, width=1):
    draw.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=color, width=width)

def rrect(draw, xy, fill, radius=10, outline=None, width=1):
    if outline:
        draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=radius, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=width)
    else:
        draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=radius, fill=fill)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CREATE CANVAS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# ── Subtle background grid (measurement/survey markers) ──
# Very faint vertical and horizontal lines suggesting a coordinate system
for gx in range(MARGIN, W - MARGIN + 1, 100):
    draw.line([(gx, 0), (gx, H)], fill=GRID_LINE, width=1)
for gy in range(0, H, 100):
    draw.line([(0, gy), (W, gy)], fill=GRID_LINE, width=1)

# Subtle top gradient for depth
for row in range(500):
    t = row / 500
    r = int(15 * (1 - t) + BG[0] * t)
    g = int(26 * (1 - t) + BG[1] * t)
    b = int(52 * (1 - t) + BG[2] * t)
    draw.line([(0, row), (W, row)], fill=(r, g, b))


# ╀─ HEADER ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
y = MARGIN
# Double accent rule
hrule(draw, y, color=AMBER, width=2)
hrule(draw, y + 7, color=(50, 65, 95), width=1)
y += 38


# ─── SECTION 1: TITLE ───────────────────────────────────────
center(draw, y, "THE STATE OF GLOBAL EDUCATION", F_TITLE, WHITE)
y += th(draw, "THE STATE OF GLOBAL EDUCATION", F_TITLE) + 14

center(draw, y, "Progress, Gaps, and Inequality", F_SUBTITLE, MUTED)
y += th(draw, "Progress, Gaps, and Inequality", F_SUBTITLE) + 35

hrule(draw, y)
y += 50


# ─── SECTION 2: HISTORICAL PROGRESS ────────────────────────
ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "TWO CENTURIES OF EXPANSION", F_SECTION, WHITE)
y += 40
# Amber accent bar
draw.line([(MARGIN, y), (MARGIN + 140, y)], fill=AMBER, width=3)
y += 25

ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "In 1800, fewer than 1 in 5 adults had any formal education.", F_BODY, MUTED)
y += 34
ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "Today, more than 4 in 5 adults have received formal schooling.", F_BODY, SOFT_WHITE)
y += 48

# ── Proportion Bars ──
BAR_H = 48
BAR_R = 6

# 1800
ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "1800", F_YEAR, MUTED)
y += 32
fill_1800 = int(COL_W * 0.17)
rrect(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN + COL_W, y + BAR_H), fill=FAINT, radius=BAR_R)
rrect(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN + fill_1800, y + BAR_H), fill=AMBER_DIM, radius=BAR_R)
ltext(draw, MARGIN + fill_1800 + 16, y + 9, "< 1 in 5", F_BODY_BOLD, AMBER)
y += BAR_H + 22

# Transformation indicator — subtle dashed vertical with chevrons
ax = MARGIN + COL_W // 2
for iy in range(y, y + 44, 7):
    draw.line([(ax, iy), (ax, iy + 3)], fill=DIM_LINE, width=1)
for i in range(3):
    cy = y + 6 + i * 16
    draw.polygon([(ax - 7, cy), (ax, cy + 7), (ax + 7, cy)], fill=TEAL_DIM)
y += 60

# Today
ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "TODAY", F_YEAR, TEAL)
y += 32
fill_today = int(COL_W * 0.83)
rrect(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN + COL_W, y + BAR_H), fill=FAINT, radius=BAR_R)
rrect(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN + fill_today, y + BAR_H), fill=TEAL, radius=BAR_R)
ltext(draw, MARGIN + fill_today + 16, y + 9, "> 4 in 5", F_BODY_BOLD, TEAL)
y += BAR_H + 30

hrule(draw, y)
y += 48


# ─── SECTION 3: 244 MILLION — HERO ─────────────────────────
# The visual center of the poster. Deep card, massive numerals.

CARD_PAD = 50
CARD_TOP = y - 16
CARD_H = 680
rrect(draw, (MARGIN - CARD_PAD, CARD_TOP, W - MARGIN + CARD_PAD, CARD_TOP + CARD_H),
      fill=BG_CARD, radius=14, outline=DIM_LINE, width=1)

y += 16

# Label
ltext(draw, MARGIN + 10, y, "OUT OF SCHOOL", F_CARD_LABEL, CORAL)
y += 44

# MONUMENTAL number
num = "244"
center(draw, y, num, F_HERO_NUM, CORAL)
y += th(draw, num, F_HERO_NUM) + 0

# MILLION
center(draw, y, "MILLION", F_HERO_LABEL, WHITE)
y += th(draw, "MILLION", F_HERO_LABEL) + 8

# CHILDREN
center(draw, y, "CHILDREN", F_COMPARE, CORAL_DIM)
y += th(draw, "CHILDREN", F_COMPARE) + 26

# Breakdown
center(draw, y, "~60 million primary-age  ·  ~184 million secondary-age", F_SMALL, MUTED)
y += 38

# ── Dot Matrix ──
# 244 dots, each = 1 million. Larger, bolder arrangement.
DOT_R = 7
DOT_GAP = 22
DOT_COLS = 20
dot_total = 244
DOT_ROWS = math.ceil(dot_total / DOT_COLS)  # 13

dot_w = DOT_COLS * DOT_GAP
dot_sx = W // 2 - dot_w // 2 + DOT_GAP // 2
dot_sy = y

count = 0
for row in range(DOT_ROWS):
    n = min(DOT_COLS, dot_total - count)
    for col in range(n):
        cx = dot_sx + col * DOT_GAP
        cy = dot_sy + row * DOT_GAP
        if count < 60:
            draw.ellipse([cx - DOT_R, cy - DOT_R, cx + DOT_R, cy + DOT_R], fill=CORAL)
        else:
            draw.ellipse([cx - DOT_R, cy - DOT_R, cx + DOT_R, cy + DOT_R], fill=CORAL_DIM)
        count += 1

dot_ey = dot_sy + DOT_ROWS * DOT_GAP
y = dot_ey + 6

# Legend
lx = dot_sx
ltext(draw, lx, y, "●", F_TINY, CORAL)
ltext(draw, lx + 22, y, "Primary-age", F_TINY, MUTED)
ltext(draw, lx + 148, y, "●", F_TINY, CORAL_DIM)
ltext(draw, lx + 170, y, "Secondary-age", F_TINY, MUTED)

y = CARD_TOP + CARD_H + 32
hrule(draw, y)
y += 48


# ─── SECTION 4: QUALITY SCHOOLING — THE DIVIDE ─────────────
ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "LEARNING-ADJUSTED YEARS OF SCHOOLING", F_SECTION, WHITE)
y += 40
draw.line([(MARGIN, y), (MARGIN + 185, y)], fill=AMBER, width=3)
y += 24

ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "Quality schooling received: a world divided", F_BODY, MUTED)
y += 48

# ── Vertical bar comparison ──
CMP_H = 420
CMP_MAX = 12
BAR_W = 170
GAP = 320

lx = W // 2 - GAP // 2 - BAR_W
rx = W // 2 + GAP // 2
bb = y + CMP_H

# Poorest (< 3 years)
ph = int(CMP_H * (3 / CMP_MAX))
rrect(draw, (lx, y, lx + BAR_W, bb), fill=FAINT, radius=8)
rrect(draw, (lx, bb - ph, lx + BAR_W, bb), fill=CORAL, radius=8)
center(draw, bb - ph + 14, "< 3", F_COMPARE, WHITE, lx + BAR_W // 2)
center(draw, bb + 12, "YEARS", F_BODY_BOLD, CORAL, lx + BAR_W // 2)
center(draw, bb + 44, "Poorest countries", F_BODY, MUTED, lx + BAR_W // 2)

rrect(draw, (rx, y, rx + BAR_W, bb), fill=FAINT, radius=8)

center(draw, bb - rh + 14, "10+", F_COMPARE, WHITE, rx + BAR_W // 2)
center(draw, bb + 12, "YEARS", F_BODY_BOLD, AMBER, rx + BAR_W // 2)
center(draw, bb + 44, "Richest countries", F_BODY, MUTED, rx + BAR_W // 2)

# VS
center(draw, y + CMP_H // 2 - 22, "VS", F_COMPARE, DIM_LINE, W // 2)

# Scale markers
for yr in range(0, 13, 3):
    my = bb - int(CMP_H * (yr / CMP_MAX))
    draw.line([(lx - 22, my), (lx - 6, my)], fill=DIM_LINE, width=1)
    rtext(draw, lx - 30, my - 8, str(yr), F_TINY, MUTED)

draw.line([(lx + BAR_W + 8, mid_y), (rx - 8, mid_y)], fill=DIM_LINE, width=1)
center(draw, mid_y - 20, "Less than a third", F_SMALL, MUTED, W // 2)

ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "Enrollment does not guarantee learning.", F_BODY, SOFT_WHITE)

SB_H = 34
sb_w = COL_W // 2 - 50
pf = int(sb_w * 0.17)

rrect(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN + sb_w, y + SB_H), fill=FAINT, radius=5)

GB_H = 10

y += 40

hrule(draw, y)
y += 44

TP = 28
tk_top = y - 8
tk_bot = y + 140
rrect(draw, (MARGIN - TP, tk_top, W - MARGIN + TP, tk_bot), fill=BG_CARD, radius=10, outline=DIM_LINE, width=1)

ltext(draw, MARGIN + 6, y, "KEY TAKEAWAY", F_CARD_LABEL, AMBER)

]:

hrule(draw, fy - 22)
ltext(draw, MARGIN, fy, "Sources: UNESCO Institute for Statistics · World Bank · Global Education Monitoring Report", F_FOOTER, MUTED)
rtext(draw, W - MARGIN, fy, "A1 Exhibition Poster · 2023 Data", F_FOOTER, MUTED)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
THE STATE OF GLOBAL EDUCATION — Monumental Contrast
A1 portrait poster: 3508 × 4967 px (150 DPI)
Third pass: museum-quality refinement — depth, texture, dramatic scale
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import math, os

# ─── Dimensions ─────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 3508, 4967
MARGIN = 240
COL_W = W - 2 * MARGIN

# ─── Color Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────
BG          = (8, 15, 30)
BG_CARD     = (13, 24, 44)
BG_DEEP     = (5, 11, 24)
AMBER       = (238, 162, 52)
AMBER_DIM   = (95, 65, 20)
AMBER_GLOW  = (200, 135, 40)
CORAL       = (230, 78, 58)
CORAL_DIM   = (90, 35, 25)
CORAL_SOFT  = (180, 60, 42)
TEAL        = (38, 178, 118)
TEAL_DIM    = (18, 75, 50)
WHITE       = (248, 248, 248)
MUTED       = (115, 133, 172)
SOFT_WHITE  = (190, 200, 218)
DIM_LINE    = (28, 42, 68)
FAINT       = (18, 30, 52)
GRID_LINE   = (14, 24, 42)

# ─── Font Loader ────────────────────────────────────────────
FDIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"
def font(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FDIR, name), size)

# ─── Fonts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
F_TITLE       = font("YoungSerif-Regular.ttf", 76)
F_SUBTITLE    = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 33)
F_HERO_NUM    = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 440)
F_HERO_LABEL  = font("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 54)
F_SECTION     = font("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 35)
F_BODY        = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 27)
F_BODY_BOLD   = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 27)
F_SMALL       = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 23)
F_TINY        = font("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 19)
F_COMPARE     = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 108)
F_YEAR        = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 30)
F_METRIC      = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 86)
F_CARD_LABEL  = font("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 26)
F_FOOTER      = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 18)
F_MEGA        = font("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 160)

# ─── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────
def tw(draw, text, fnt):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=fnt)
    return bb[2] - bb[0]

def th(draw, text, fnt):
    bb = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=fnt)
    return bb[3] - bb[1]

def center(draw, y, text, fnt, fill, cx=None):
    if cx is None: cx = W // 2
    t = tw(draw, text, fnt)
    draw.text((cx - t // 2, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)
    return th(draw, text, fnt)

def ltext(draw, x, y, text, fnt, fill):
    draw.text((x, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)
    return th(draw, text, fnt)

def rtext(draw, x, y, text, fnt, fill):
    t = tw(draw, text, fnt)
    draw.text((x - t, y), text, font=fnt, fill=fill)
    return th(draw, text, fnt)

def hrule(draw, y, x1=MARGIN, x2=W - MARGIN, color=DIM_LINE, width=1):
    draw.line([(x1, y), (x2, y)], fill=color, width=width)

def rrect(draw, xy, fill, radius=10, outline=None, width=1):
    if outline:
        draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=radius, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=width)
    else:
        draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=radius, fill=fill)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# CREATE CANVAS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# ── Subtle background grid (measurement/survey markers) ──
# Very faint vertical and horizontal lines suggesting a coordinate system
for gx in range(MARGIN, W - MARGIN + 1, 100):
    draw.line([(gx, 0), (gx, H)], fill=GRID_LINE, width=1)
for gy in range(0, H, 100):
    draw.line([(0, gy), (W, gy)], fill=GRID_LINE, width=1)

# Subtle top gradient for depth
for row in range(500):
    t = row / 500
    r = int(15 * (1 - t) + BG[0] * t)
    g = int(26 * (1 - t) + BG[1] * t)
    b = int(52 * (1 - t) + BG[2] * t)
    draw.line([(0, row), (W, row)], fill=(r, g, b))


# ╀─ HEADER ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
y = MARGIN
# Double accent rule
hrule(draw, y, color=AMBER, width=2)
hrule(draw, y + 7, color=(50, 65, 95), width=1)
y += 38


# ─── SECTION 1: TITLE ───────────────────────────────────────
center(draw, y, "THE STATE OF GLOBAL EDUCATION", F_TITLE, WHITE)
y += th(draw, "THE STATE OF GLOBAL EDUCATION", F_TITLE) + 14

center(draw, y, "Progress, Gaps, and Inequality", F_SUBTITLE, MUTED)
y += th(draw, "Progress, Gaps, and Inequality", F_SUBTITLE) + 35

hrule(draw, y)
y += 50


# ─── SECTION 2: HISTORICAL PROGRESS ────────────────────────
ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "TWO CENTURIES OF EXPANSION", F_SECTION, WHITE)
y += 40
# Amber accent bar
draw.line([(MARGIN, y), (MARGIN + 140, y)], fill=AMBER, width=3)
y += 25

ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "In 1800, fewer than 1 in 5 adults had any formal education.", F_BODY, MUTED)
y += 34
ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "Today, more than 4 in 5 adults have received formal schooling.", F_BODY, SOFT_WHITE)
y += 48

# ── Proportion Bars ──
BAR_H = 48
BAR_R = 6

# 1800
ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "1800", F_YEAR, MUTED)
y += 32
fill_1800 = int(COL_W * 0.17)
rrect(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN + COL_W, y + BAR_H), fill=FAINT, radius=BAR_R)
rrect(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN + fill_1800, y + BAR_H), fill=AMBER_DIM, radius=BAR_R)
ltext(draw, MARGIN + fill_1800 + 16, y + 9, "< 1 in 5", F_BODY_BOLD, AMBER)
y += BAR_H + 22

# Transformation indicator — subtle dashed vertical with chevrons
ax = MARGIN + COL_W // 2
for iy in range(y, y + 44, 7):
    draw.line([(ax, iy), (ax, iy + 3)], fill=DIM_LINE, width=1)
for i in range(3):
    cy = y + 6 + i * 16
    draw.polygon([(ax - 7, cy), (ax, cy + 7), (ax + 7, cy)], fill=TEAL_DIM)
y += 60

# Today
ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "TODAY", F_YEAR, TEAL)
y += 32
fill_today = int(COL_W * 0.83)
rrect(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN + COL_W, y + BAR_H), fill=FAINT, radius=BAR_R)
rrect(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN + fill_today, y + BAR_H), fill=TEAL, radius=BAR_R)
ltext(draw, MARGIN + fill_today + 16, y + 9, "> 4 in 5", F_BODY_BOLD, TEAL)
y += BAR_H + 30

hrule(draw, y)
y += 48


# ─── SECTION 3: 244 MILLION — HERO ─────────────────────────
# The visual center of the poster. Deep card, massive numerals.

CARD_PAD = 50
CARD_TOP = y - 16
CARD_H = 680
rrect(draw, (MARGIN - CARD_PAD, CARD_TOP, W - MARGIN + CARD_PAD, CARD_TOP + CARD_H),
      fill=BG_CARD, radius=14, outline=DIM_LINE, width=1)

y += 16

# Label
ltext(draw, MARGIN + 10, y, "OUT OF SCHOOL", F_CARD_LABEL, CORAL)
y += 44

# MONUMENTAL number
num = "244"
center(draw, y, num, F_HERO_NUM, CORAL)
y += th(draw, num, F_HERO_NUM) + 0

# MILLION
center(draw, y, "MILLION", F_HERO_LABEL, WHITE)
y += th(draw, "MILLION", F_HERO_LABEL) + 8

# CHILDREN
center(draw, y, "CHILDREN", F_COMPARE, CORAL_DIM)
y += th(draw, "CHILDREN", F_COMPARE) + 26

# Breakdown
center(draw, y, "~60 million primary-age  ·  ~184 million secondary-age", F_SMALL, MUTED)
y += 38

# ── Dot Matrix ──
# 244 dots, each = 1 million. Larger, bolder arrangement.
DOT_R = 7
DOT_GAP = 22
DOT_COLS = 20
dot_total = 244
DOT_ROWS = math.ceil(dot_total / DOT_COLS)  # 13

dot_w = DOT_COLS * DOT_GAP
dot_sx = W // 2 - dot_w // 2 + DOT_GAP // 2
dot_sy = y

count = 0
for row in range(DOT_ROWS):
    n = min(DOT_COLS, dot_total - count)
    for col in range(n):
        cx = dot_sx + col * DOT_GAP
        cy = dot_sy + row * DOT_GAP
        if count < 60:
            draw.ellipse([cx - DOT_R, cy - DOT_R, cx + DOT_R, cy + DOT_R], fill=CORAL)
        else:
            draw.ellipse([cx - DOT_R, cy - DOT_R, cx + DOT_R, cy + DOT_R], fill=CORAL_DIM)
        count += 1

dot_ey = dot_sy + DOT_ROWS * DOT_GAP
y = dot_ey + 6

# Legend
lx = dot_sx
ltext(draw, lx, y, "●", F_TINY, CORAL)
ltext(draw, lx + 22, y, "Primary-age", F_TINY, MUTED)
ltext(draw, lx + 148, y, "●", F_TINY, CORAL_DIM)
ltext(draw, lx + 170, y, "Secondary-age", F_TINY, MUTED)

y = CARD_TOP + CARD_H + 32
hrule(draw, y)
y += 48


# ─── SECTION 4: QUALITY SCHOOLING — THE DIVIDE ─────────────
ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "LEARNING-ADJUSTED YEARS OF SCHOOLING", F_SECTION, WHITE)
y += 40
draw.line([(MARGIN, y), (MARGIN + 185, y)], fill=AMBER, width=3)
y += 24

ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "Quality schooling received: a world divided", F_BODY, MUTED)
y += 48

# ── Vertical bar comparison ──
CMP_H = 420
CMP_MAX = 12
BAR_W = 170
GAP = 320

lx = W // 2 - GAP // 2 - BAR_W
rx = W // 2 + GAP // 2
bb = y + CMP_H

# Poorest (< 3 years)
ph = int(CMP_H * (3 / CMP_MAX))
rrect(draw, (lx, y, lx + BAR_W, bb), fill=FAINT, radius=8)
rrect(draw, (lx, bb - ph, lx + BAR_W, bb), fill=CORAL, radius=8)
center(draw, bb - ph + 14, "< 3", F_COMPARE, WHITE, lx + BAR_W // 2)
center(draw, bb + 12, "YEARS", F_BODY_BOLD, CORAL, lx + BAR_W // 2)
center(draw, bb + 44, "Poorest countries", F_BODY, MUTED, lx + BAR_W // 2)

# Richest (10+ years)
rh = int(CMP_H * (10.5 / CMP_MAX))
rrect(draw, (rx, y, rx + BAR_W, bb), fill=FAINT, radius=8)
rrect(draw, (rx, bb - rh, rx + BAR_W, bb), fill=AMBER, radius=8)
center(draw, bb - rh + 14, "10+", F_COMPARE, WHITE, rx + BAR_W // 2)
center(draw, bb + 12, "YEARS", F_BODY_BOLD, AMBER, rx + BAR_W // 2)
center(draw, bb + 44, "Richest countries", F_BODY, MUTED, rx + BAR_W // 2)

# VS
center(draw, y + CMP_H // 2 - 22, "VS", F_COMPARE, DIM_LINE, W // 2)

# Scale markers
for yr in range(0, 13, 3):
    my = bb - int(CMP_H * (yr / CMP_MAX))
    draw.line([(lx - 22, my), (lx - 6, my)], fill=DIM_LINE, width=1)
    rtext(draw, lx - 30, my - 8, str(yr), F_TINY, MUTED)

# Connecting bracket annotation
mid_y = bb - rh // 2
draw.line([(lx + BAR_W + 8, mid_y), (rx - 8, mid_y)], fill=DIM_LINE, width=1)
center(draw, mid_y - 20, "Less than a third", F_SMALL, MUTED, W // 2)
center(draw, mid_y + 4, "of quality schooling", F_SMALL, MUTED, W // 2)

y = bb + 80
hrule(draw, y)
y += 48


# ─── SECTION 5: LEARNING CRISIS ─────────────────────────────
ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "THE LEARNING CRISIS", F_SECTION, WHITE)
y += 40
draw.line([(MARGIN, y), (MARGIN + 125, y)], fill=CORAL, width=3)
y += 22

ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "Enrollment does not guarantee learning.", F_BODY, SOFT_WHITE)
y += 38

# Proportion bar + metric
SB_H = 34
sb_w = COL_W // 2 - 50
pf = int(sb_w * 0.17)

rrect(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN + sb_w, y + SB_H), fill=FAINT, radius=5)
rrect(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN + pf, y + SB_H), fill=CORAL, radius=5)

mx = MARGIN + sb_w + 24
ltext(draw, mx, y - 5, "< 20%", F_METRIC, CORAL)
ltext(draw, mx, y + 65, "of children achieve minimum reading", F_BODY, MUTED)
ltext(draw, mx, y + 92, "proficiency in low-income countries", F_BODY, MUTED)

y += SB_H + 115
hrule(draw, y)
y += 48


# ─── SECTION 6: GENDER GAP ─────────────────────────────────
ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "CLOSING THE GENDER GAP", F_SECTION, WHITE)
y += 40
draw.line([(MARGIN, y), (MARGIN + 140, y)], fill=TEAL, width=3)
y += 22

GAP_COL = (COL_W - 50) // 3
GB_H = 10

levels = [
    ("Primary",   0.98, "Nearly closed",    TEAL_DIM),
    ("Secondary", 0.96, "Nearly closed",    TEAL_DIM),
    ("Tertiary",  1.05, "Women exceed men", TEAL),
]

for i, (label, ratio, status, col) in enumerate(levels):
    bx = MARGIN + i * (GAP_COL + 25)
    ltext(draw, bx, y, label, F_BODY_BOLD, SOFT_WHITE)
    by = y + 30
    bf = int(GAP_COL * min(ratio, 1.0))
    rrect(draw, (bx, by, bx + GAP_COL, by + GB_H), fill=FAINT, radius=4)
    rrect(draw, (bx, by, bx + bf, by + GB_H), fill=col, radius=4)
    ltext(draw, bx, by + GB_H + 8, status, F_SMALL, MUTED)

y += 30 + GB_H + 44

# Exception
ltext(draw, MARGIN, y, "Exception: In Afghanistan, girls remain far less likely to attend school.", F_SMALL, CORAL_DIM)
y += 40

hrule(draw, y)
y += 44


# ─── SECTION 7: KEY TAKEAWAY ────────────────────────────────
TP = 28
tk_top = y - 8
tk_bot = y + 140
rrect(draw, (MARGIN - TP, tk_top, W - MARGIN + TP, tk_bot), fill=BG_CARD, radius=10, outline=DIM_LINE, width=1)

y += 4
ltext(draw, MARGIN + 6, y, "KEY TAKEAWAY", F_CARD_LABEL, AMBER)
y += 36

for line in [
    "Remarkable progress — but the job is far from done.",
    "Hundreds of millions of children are out of school or learning very little.",
    "Closing the gap between enrollment and learning, and between rich and poor",
    "nations, is one of the most pressing challenges of our time.",
]:
    ltext(draw, MARGIN + 6, y, line, F_BODY, SOFT_WHITE)
    y += 30

y = tk_bot + 24


# ─── FOOTER ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
fy = H - MARGIN + 8
hrule(draw, fy - 22)
ltext(draw, MARGIN, fy, "Sources: UNESCO Institute for Statistics · World Bank · Global Education Monitoring Report", F_FOOTER, MUTED)
rtext(draw, W - MARGIN, fy, "A1 Exhibition Poster · 2023 Data", F_FOOTER, MUTED)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SAVE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
out_path = "/app/output/final_poster.png"
img.save(out_path, "PNG", optimize=True)
print(f"Saved: {out_path}  ({W}×{H}px)")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
THE STATE OF GLOBAL EDUCATION — Monumental Contrast
A1 portrait poster: 3508 × 4967 px (150 DPI)
Final pass: museum-quality — every pixel intentional
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont, ImageFilter
import math, os

# ─── Canvas ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 3508, 4967
MARGIN = 240
COL_W = W - 2 * MARGIN

# ─── Palette ────────────────────────────────────────────────
BG         = (8, 15, 30)
BG_CARD    = (12, 23, 42)
AMBER      = (240, 165, 50)
AMBER_DIM  = (90, 62, 18)
CORAL      = (232, 76, 56)
CORAL_DIM  = (85, 33, 24)
TEAL       = (36, 180, 116)
TEAL_DIM   = (17, 72, 48)
WHITE      = (250, 250, 250)
MUTED      = (112, 130, 168)
SOFT_WHITE = (188, 198, 216)
DIM_LINE   = (26, 40, 66)
FAINT      = (17, 28, 50)
GRID_COL   = (12, 22, 38)

# ─── Fonts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
FD = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"
def f(name, sz): return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FD, name), sz)

FT  = f("YoungSerif-Regular.ttf", 74)       # title
FS  = f("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 32)    # subtitle
FH  = f("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 460)       # hero 244
FHL = f("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 56)            # "MILLION"
FC  = f("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 112)       # "CHILDREN"
FSE = f("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 34)            # section titles
FB  = f("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 26)    # body
FBB = f("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 26)       # body bold
FSM = f("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 22)    # small
FTN = f("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 18)         # tiny mono
FYR = f("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 29)           # year labels
FMT = f("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 84)        # metric (<20%)
FCL = f("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 25)           # card labels
FFR = f("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 17)    # footer

# ─── Drawing helpers ────────────────────────────────────────
def tw(d, t, fn): bb = d.textbbox((0,0),t,font=fn); return bb[2]-bb[0]
def th(d, t, fn): bb = d.textbbox((0,0),t,font=fn); return bb[3]-bb[1]

def ct(d, y, t, fn, c, cx=None):
    if cx is None: cx = W//2
    d.text((cx - tw(d,t,fn)//2, y), t, font=fn, fill=c)
    return th(d,t,fn)

def lt(d, x, y, t, fn, c):
    d.text((x,y), t, font=fn, fill=c)
    return th(d,t,fn)

def rt(d, x, y, t, fn, c):
    w = tw(d,t,fn); d.text((x-w,y), t, font=fn, fill=c)
    return th(d,t,fn)

def hr(d, y, x1=MARGIN, x2=W-MARGIN, c=DIM_LINE, w=1):
    d.line([(x1,y),(x2,y)], fill=c, width=w)

def rr(d, xy, fill, r=8, ol=None, w=1):
    if ol: d.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=r, fill=fill, outline=ol, width=w)
    else:  d.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=r, fill=fill)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# BUILD
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# ── Background grid: extremely subtle measurement markers ──
for gx in range(MARGIN, W-MARGIN+1, 120):
    draw.line([(gx,0),(gx,H)], fill=GRID_COL, width=1)
for gy in range(0, H+1, 120):
    draw.line([(0,gy),(W,gy)], fill=GRID_COL, width=1)

# Top gradient veil
for row in range(450):
    t = row / 450
    c = tuple(int(BG[i] + (14-BG[i])*(1-t)*0.7 + BG[i]*t) for i in range(3))
    draw.line([(0,row),(W,row)], fill=c)

# ── Corner crop marks (registration marks — subtle design accent) ──
CM = 60   # mark length
CO = 40   # offset from edge
for cx, cy in [(CO,CO), (W-CO,CO), (CO,H-CO), (W-CO,H-CO)]:
    dx = 1 if cx < W//2 else -1
    dy = 1 if cy < H//2 else -1
    draw.line([(cx, cy), (cx + dx*CM, cy)], fill=DIM_LINE, width=1)
    draw.line([(cx, cy), (cx, cy + dy*CM)], fill=DIM_LINE, width=1)


# ╀─ HEADER RULE ──────────────────────────────────────────────
y = MARGIN
hr(draw, y, c=AMBER, w=2)
hr(draw, y+6, c=(40,55,85), w=1)
y += 36


# ─── TITLE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
ct(draw, y, "THE STATE OF GLOBAL EDUCATION", FT, WHITE)
y += th(draw, "THE STATE OF GLOBAL EDUCATION", FT) + 10
ct(draw, y, "Progress, Gaps, and Inequality", FS, MUTED)
y += th(draw, "Progress, Gaps, and Inequality", FS) + 32
hr(draw, y)
y += 46


# ─── HISTORICAL PROGRESS ────────────────────────────────────
lt(draw, MARGIN, y, "TWO CENTURIES OF EXPANSION", FSE, WHITE)
y += 38
draw.line([(MARGIN, y), (MARGIN+130, y)], fill=AMBER, w=3)
y += 22
lt(draw, MARGIN, y, "In 1800, fewer than 1 in 5 adults had any formal education.", FB, MUTED)
y += 32
lt(draw, MARGIN, y, "Today, more than 4 in 5 adults have received formal schooling.", FB, SOFT_WHITE)
y += 44

# 1800 bar
BH = 44; BR = 6
lt(draw, MARGIN, y, "1800", FYR, MUTED)
y += 30
fw = int(COL_W * 0.17)
rr(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN+COL_W, y+BH), FAINT, BR)
rr(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN+fw, y+BH), AMBER_DIM, BR)
lt(draw, MARGIN+fw+14, y+8, "< 1 in 5", FBB, AMBER)
y += BH + 18

# Transformation: dashed line + chevrons
ax = MARGIN + COL_W//2
for iy in range(y, y+38, 7):
    draw.line([(ax,iy),(ax,iy+3)], fill=DIM_LINE, w=1)
for i in range(3):
    cy = y+5+i*14
    draw.polygon([(ax-6,cy),(ax,cy+6),(ax+6,cy)], fill=TEAL_DIM)
y += 52

# Today bar
lt(draw, MARGIN, y, "TODAY", FYR, TEAL)
y += 30
ft = int(COL_W * 0.83)
rr(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN+COL_W, y+BH), FAINT, BR)
rr(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN+ft, y+BH), TEAL, BR)
lt(draw, MARGIN+ft+14, y+8, "> 4 in 5", FBB, TEAL)
y += BH + 26
hr(draw, y)
y += 44


# ─── 244 MILLION — HERO ────────────────────────────────────
CP = 44
CT = y - 14
CH = 660
rr(draw, (MARGIN-CP, CT, W-MARGIN+CP, CT+CH), BG_CARD, 14, DIM_LINE, 1)

y += 14

lt(draw, MARGIN+8, y, "OUT OF SCHOOL", FCL, CORAL)
y += 40

# The number — monumental
ct(draw, y, "244", FH, CORAL)
y += th(draw, "244", FH) - 2

ct(draw, y, "MILLION", FHL, WHITE)
y += th(draw, "MILLION", FHL) + 6

ct(draw, y, "CHILDREN", FC, CORAL_DIM)
y += th(draw, "CHILDREN", FC) + 24

ct(draw, y, "~60 million primary-age  ·  ~184 million secondary-age", FSM, MUTED)
y += 34

# Dot matrix — each dot = 1 million children
DR = 7; DG = 21; DC = 22
total = 244
DRs = math.ceil(total / DC)  # 12 rows
dw = DC * DG
dsx = W//2 - dw//2 + DG//2
dsy = y

count = 0
for row in range(DRs):
    n = min(DC, total - count)
    for col in range(n):
        cx = dsx + col * DG
        cy = dsy + row * DG
        if count < 60:
            draw.ellipse([cx-DR, cy-DR, cx+DR, cy+DR], fill=CORAL)
        else:
            draw.ellipse([cx-DR, cy-DR, cx+DR, cy+DR], fill=CORAL_DIM)
        count += 1

dey = dsy + DRs * DG
y = dey + 4

# Legend
lt(draw, dsx, y, "●", FTN, CORAL)
lt(draw, dsx+20, y, "Primary-age", FTN, MUTED)
lt(draw, dsx+136, y, "●", FTN, CORAL_DIM)
lt(draw, dsx+156, y, "Secondary-age", FTN, MUTED)

y = CT + CH + 28
hr(draw, y)
y += 44


# ─── QUALITY SCHOOLING — THE DIVIDE ────────────────────────
lt(draw, MARGIN, y, "LEARNING-ADJUSTED YEARS OF SCHOOLING", FSE, WHITE)
y += 38
draw.line([(MARGIN, y), (MARGIN+175, y)], fill=AMBER, w=3)
y += 20
lt(draw, MARGIN, y, "Quality schooling received: a world divided", FB, MUTED)
y += 42

# Vertical bar comparison
CMH = 400; CMAX = 12; BW = 160; GAP2 = 310
lx = W//2 - GAP2//2 - BW
rx = W//2 + GAP2//2
bb = y + CMH

# Poorest
ph = int(CMH * 3/CMAX)
rr(draw, (lx, y, lx+BW, bb), FAINT, 8)
rr(draw, (lx, bb-ph, lx+BW, bb), CORAL, 8)
ct(draw, bb-ph+12, "< 3", FC, WHITE, lx+BW//2)
ct(draw, bb+10, "YEARS", FBB, CORAL, lx+BW//2)
ct(draw, bb+40, "Poorest countries", FB, MUTED, lx+BW//2)

# Richest
rh = int(CMH * 10.5/CMAX)
rr(draw, (rx, y, rx+BW, bb), FAINT, 8)
rr(draw, (rx, bb-rh, rx+BW, bb), AMBER, 8)
ct(draw, bb-rh+12, "10+", FC, WHITE, rx+BW//2)
ct(draw, bb+10, "YEARS", FBB, AMBER, rx+BW//2)
ct(draw, bb+40, "Richest countries", FB, MUTED, rx+BW//2)

# VS
ct(draw, y+CMH//2-20, "VS", FC, DIM_LINE, W//2)

# Scale
for yr in range(0, 13, 3):
    my = bb - int(CMH * yr/CMAX)
    draw.line([(lx-20,my),(lx-5,my)], fill=DIM_LINE, w=1)
    rt(draw, lx-26, my-7, str(yr), FTN, MUTED)

# Connecting annotation
middy = bb - rh//2
draw.line([(lx+BW+6,middy),(rx-6,middy)], fill=DIM_LINE, w=1)
ct(draw, middy-18, "Less than a third", FSM, MUTED, W//2)
ct(draw, middy+4, "of quality schooling", FSM, MUTED, W//2)

y = bb + 72
hr(draw, y)
y += 44


# ─── LEARNING CRISIS ────────────────────────────────────────
lt(draw, MARGIN, y, "THE LEARNING CRISIS", FSE, WHITE)
y += 38
draw.line([(MARGIN, y), (MARGIN+115, y)], fill=CORAL, w=3)
y += 18
lt(draw, MARGIN, y, "Enrollment does not guarantee learning.", FB, SOFT_WHITE)
y += 34

SBH = 32; sbw = COL_W//2 - 40
pf = int(sbw * 0.17)
rr(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN+sbw, y+SBH), FAINT, 5)
rr(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN+pf, y+SBH), CORAL, 5)

DIM_LINE   = (26, 40, 66)
FAINT      = (17, 28, 50)
GRID_COL   = (12, 22, 38)

# ─── Fonts ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
FD = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts/"
def f(name, sz): return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FD, name), sz)

FT  = f("YoungSerif-Regular.ttf", 74)       # title
FS  = f("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 32)    # subtitle
FH  = f("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 460)       # hero 244
FHL = f("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 56)            # "MILLION"
FC  = f("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 112)       # "CHILDREN"
FSE = f("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 34)            # section titles
FB  = f("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 26)    # body
FBB = f("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 26)       # body bold
FSM = f("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 22)    # small
FTN = f("GeistMono-Regular.ttf", 18)         # tiny mono
FYR = f("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 29)           # year labels
FMT = f("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 84)        # metric (<20%)
FCL = f("GeistMono-Bold.ttf", 25)           # card labels
FFR = f("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 17)    # footer

# ─── Drawing helpers ────────────────────────────────────────
def tw(d, t, fn): bb = d.textbbox((0,0),t,font=fn); return bb[2]-bb[0]
def th(d, t, fn): bb = d.textbbox((0,0),t,font=fn); return bb[3]-bb[1]

def ct(d, y, t, fn, c, cx=None):
    if cx is None: cx = W//2
    d.text((cx - tw(d,t,fn)//2, y), t, font=fn, fill=c)
    return th(d,t,fn)

def lt(d, x, y, t, fn, c):
    d.text((x,y), t, font=fn, fill=c)
    return th(d,t,fn)

def rt(d, x, y, t, fn, c):
    w = tw(d,t,fn); d.text((x-w,y), t, font=fn, fill=c)
    return th(d,t,fn)

def hr(d, y, x1=MARGIN, x2=W-MARGIN, c=DIM_LINE, w=1):
    d.line([(x1,y),(x2,y)], fill=c, width=w)

def rr(d, xy, fill, r=8, ol=None, w=1):
    if ol: d.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=r, fill=fill, outline=ol, width=w)
    else:  d.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=r, fill=fill)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# BUILD
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# ── Background grid: extremely subtle measurement markers ──
for gx in range(MARGIN, W-MARGIN+1, 120):
    draw.line([(gx,0),(gx,H)], fill=GRID_COL, width=1)
for gy in range(0, H+1, 120):
    draw.line([(0,gy),(W,gy)], fill=GRID_COL, width=1)

# Top gradient veil
for row in range(450):
    t = row / 450
    c = tuple(int(BG[i] + (14-BG[i])*(1-t)*0.7 + BG[i]*t) for i in range(3))
    draw.line([(0,row),(W,row)], fill=c)

# ── Corner crop marks (registration marks — subtle design accent) ──
CM = 60   # mark length
CO = 40   # offset from edge
for cx, cy in [(CO,CO), (W-CO,CO), (CO,H-CO), (W-CO,H-CO)]:
    dx = 1 if cx < W//2 else -1
    dy = 1 if cy < H//2 else -1
    draw.line([(cx, cy), (cx + dx*CM, cy)], fill=DIM_LINE, width=1)
    draw.line([(cx, cy), (cx, cy + dy*CM)], fill=DIM_LINE, width=1)


# ╀─ HEADER RULE ──────────────────────────────────────────────
y = MARGIN
hr(draw, y, c=AMBER, w=2)
hr(draw, y+6, c=(40,55,85), w=1)
y += 36


# ─── TITLE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
ct(draw, y, "THE STATE OF GLOBAL EDUCATION", FT, WHITE)
y += th(draw, "THE STATE OF GLOBAL EDUCATION", FT) + 10
ct(draw, y, "Progress, Gaps, and Inequality", FS, MUTED)
y += th(draw, "Progress, Gaps, and Inequality", FS) + 32
hr(draw, y)
y += 46


# ─── HISTORICAL PROGRESS ────────────────────────────────────
lt(draw, MARGIN, y, "TWO CENTURIES OF EXPANSION", FSE, WHITE)
y += 38
draw.line([(MARGIN, y), (MARGIN+130, y)], fill=AMBER, w=3)
y += 22
lt(draw, MARGIN, y, "In 1800, fewer than 1 in 5 adults had any formal education.", FB, MUTED)
y += 32
lt(draw, MARGIN, y, "Today, more than 4 in 5 adults have received formal schooling.", FB, SOFT_WHITE)
y += 44

# 1800 bar
BH = 44; BR = 6
lt(draw, MARGIN, y, "1800", FYR, MUTED)
y += 30
fw = int(COL_W * 0.17)
rr(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN+COL_W, y+BH), FAINT, BR)
rr(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN+fw, y+BH), AMBER_DIM, BR)
lt(draw, MARGIN+fw+14, y+8, "< 1 in 5", FBB, AMBER)
y += BH + 18

# Transformation: dashed line + chevrons
ax = MARGIN + COL_W//2
for iy in range(y, y+38, 7):
    draw.line([(ax,iy),(ax,iy+3)], fill=DIM_LINE, w=1)
for i in range(3):
    cy = y+5+i*14
    draw.polygon([(ax-6,cy),(ax,cy+6),(ax+6,cy)], fill=TEAL_DIM)
y += 52

# Today bar
lt(draw, MARGIN, y, "TODAY", FYR, TEAL)
y += 30
ft = int(COL_W * 0.83)
rr(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN+COL_W, y+BH), FAINT, BR)
rr(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN+ft, y+BH), TEAL, BR)
lt(draw, MARGIN+ft+14, y+8, "> 4 in 5", FBB, TEAL)
y += BH + 26
hr(draw, y)
y += 44


# ─── 244 MILLION — HERO ────────────────────────────────────
CP = 44
CT = y - 14
CH = 660
rr(draw, (MARGIN-CP, CT, W-MARGIN+CP, CT+CH), BG_CARD, 14, DIM_LINE, 1)

y += 14

lt(draw, MARGIN+8, y, "OUT OF SCHOOL", FCL, CORAL)
y += 40

# The number — monumental
ct(draw, y, "244", FH, CORAL)
y += th(draw, "244", FH) - 2

ct(draw, y, "MILLION", FHL, WHITE)
y += th(draw, "MILLION", FHL) + 6

ct(draw, y, "CHILDREN", FC, CORAL_DIM)
y += th(draw, "CHILDREN", FC) + 24

ct(draw, y, "~60 million primary-age  ·  ~184 million secondary-age", FSM, MUTED)
y += 34

# Dot matrix — each dot = 1 million children
DR = 7; DG = 21; DC = 22
total = 244
DRs = math.ceil(total / DC)  # 12 rows
dw = DC * DG
dsx = W//2 - dw//2 + DG//2
dsy = y

count = 0
for row in range(DRs):
    n = min(DC, total - count)
    for col in range(n):
        cx = dsx + col * DG
        cy = dsy + row * DG
        if count < 60:
            draw.ellipse([cx-DR, cy-DR, cx+DR, cy+DR], fill=CORAL)
        else:
            draw.ellipse([cx-DR, cy-DR, cx+DR, cy+DR], fill=CORAL_DIM)
        count += 1

dey = dsy + DRs * DG
y = dey + 4

# Legend
lt(draw, dsx, y, "●", FTN, CORAL)
lt(draw, dsx+20, y, "Primary-age", FTN, MUTED)
lt(draw, dsx+136, y, "●", FTN, CORAL_DIM)
lt(draw, dsx+156, y, "Secondary-age", FTN, MUTED)

y = CT + CH + 28
hr(draw, y)
y += 44


# ─── QUALITY SCHOOLING — THE DIVIDE ────────────────────────
lt(draw, MARGIN, y, "LEARNING-ADJUSTED YEARS OF SCHOOLING", FSE, WHITE)
y += 38
draw.line([(MARGIN, y), (MARGIN+175, y)], fill=AMBER, w=3)
y += 20
lt(draw, MARGIN, y, "Quality schooling received: a world divided", FB, MUTED)
y += 42

# Vertical bar comparison
CMH = 400; CMAX = 12; BW = 160; GAP2 = 310
lx = W//2 - GAP2//2 - BW
rx = W//2 + GAP2//2
bb = y + CMH

# Poorest
ph = int(CMH * 3/CMAX)
rr(draw, (lx, y, lx+BW, bb), FAINT, 8)
rr(draw, (lx, bb-ph, lx+BW, bb), CORAL, 8)
ct(draw, bb-ph+12, "< 3", FC, WHITE, lx+BW//2)
ct(draw, bb+10, "YEARS", FBB, CORAL, lx+BW//2)
ct(draw, bb+40, "Poorest countries", FB, MUTED, lx+BW//2)

# Richest
rh = int(CMH * 10.5/CMAX)
rr(draw, (rx, y, rx+BW, bb), FAINT, 8)
rr(draw, (rx, bb-rh, rx+BW, bb), AMBER, 8)
ct(draw, bb-rh+12, "10+", FC, WHITE, rx+BW//2)
ct(draw, bb+10, "YEARS", FBB, AMBER, rx+BW//2)
ct(draw, bb+40, "Richest countries", FB, MUTED, rx+BW//2)

# VS
ct(draw, y+CMH//2-20, "VS", FC, DIM_LINE, W//2)

# Scale
for yr in range(0, 13, 3):
    my = bb - int(CMH * yr/CMAX)
    draw.line([(lx-20,my),(lx-5,my)], fill=DIM_LINE, w=1)
    rt(draw, lx-26, my-7, str(yr), FTN, MUTED)

# Connecting annotation
middy = bb - rh//2
draw.line([(lx+BW+6,middy),(rx-6,middy)], fill=DIM_LINE, w=1)
ct(draw, middy-18, "Less than a third", FSM, MUTED, W//2)
ct(draw, middy+4, "of quality schooling", FSM, MUTED, W//2)

y = bb + 72
hr(draw, y)
y += 44


# ─── LEARNING CRISIS ────────────────────────────────────────
lt(draw, MARGIN, y, "THE LEARNING CRISIS", FSE, WHITE)
y += 38
draw.line([(MARGIN, y), (MARGIN+115, y)], fill=CORAL, w=3)
y += 18
lt(draw, MARGIN, y, "Enrollment does not guarantee learning.", FB, SOFT_WHITE)
y += 34

SBH = 32; sbw = COL_W//2 - 40
pf = int(sbw * 0.17)
rr(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN+sbw, y+SBH), FAINT, 5)
rr(draw, (MARGIN, y, MARGIN+pf, y+SBH), CORAL, 5)

mx = MARGIN+sbw+20
lt(draw, mx, y-4, "< 20%", FMT, CORAL)
lt(draw, mx, y+60, "of children achieve minimum reading", FB, MUTED)
lt(draw, mx, y+86, "proficiency in low-income countries", FB, MUTED)

y += SBH + 108
hr(draw, y)
y += 44


# ─── GENDER GAP ─────────────────────────────────────────────
lt(draw, MARGIN, y, "CLOSING THE GENDER GAP", FSE, WHITE)
y += 38
draw.line([(MARGIN, y), (MARGIN+130, y)], fill=TEAL, w=3)
y += 18

GC = (COL_W-45)//3; GH = 9
levels = [("Primary",0.98,"Nearly closed",TEAL_DIM),
          ("Secondary",0.96,"Nearly closed",TEAL_DIM),
          ("Tertiary",1.05,"Women exceed men",TEAL)]
for i,(lab,rat,st,col) in enumerate(levels):
    bx = MARGIN + i*(GC+22)
    lt(draw, bx, y, lab, FBB, SOFT_WHITE)
    by = y+28
    bf = int(GC * min(rat,1.0))
    rr(draw, (bx,by,bx+GC,by+GH), FAINT, 4)
    rr(draw, (bx,by,bx+bf,by+GH), col, 4)
    lt(draw, bx, by+GH+6, st, FSM, MUTED)

y += 28+GH+38

lt(draw, MARGIN, y, "Exception: In Afghanistan, girls remain far less likely to attend school.", FSM, CORAL_DIM)
y += 36
hr(draw, y)
y += 40


# ─── KEY TAKEAWAY ────────────────────────────────────────────
TP = 26; tkt = y-6; tkb = y+132
rr(draw, (MARGIN-TP, tkt, W-MARGIN+TP, tkb), BG_CARD, 10, DIM_LINE, 1)

y += 2
lt(draw, MARGIN+4, y, "KEY TAKEAWAY", FCL, AMBER)
y += 32

for line in [
    "Remarkable progress — but the job is far from done.",
    "Hundreds of millions of children are out of school or learning very little.",
    "Closing the gap between enrollment and learning, and between rich and poor",
    "nations, is one of the most pressing challenges of our time.",
]:
    lt(draw, MARGIN+4, y, line, FB, SOFT_WHITE)
    y += 28

y = tkb + 20


# ─── FOOTER ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
fy = H - MARGIN + 6
hr(draw, fy-18)
lt(draw, MARGIN, fy, "Sources: UNESCO Institute for Statistics · World Bank · Global Education Monitoring Report", FFR, MUTED)
rt(draw, W-MARGIN, fy, "A1 Exhibition Poster · 2023 Data", FFR, MUTED)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SAVE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
out_path = "/app/output/final_poster.png"
img.save(out_path, "PNG", optimize=True)
print(f"Saved: {out_path}  ({W}×{H}px)")
